content: {"praised":["Acting is wonderfully performed by all cast members.","Humor is sharp and engaging throughout the film.","Story is well scripted and touching for families.","Characters are finely tuned and relatable.","Kid actor playing Kyle is amazing."],"criticized":["Pacing is slow and boring.","Characters lack depth and growth.","Plot is unclear and forgettable.","Forced to watch coming attractions.","No central theme like determination."]}
